about: P3 Home on time: Local dry van by the hour, home daily, dedicated account.

brief.subject: Class A local dry van driver

recipe.name: P3 Home on time
recipe.hook_formula: Lead with being home, then the facts that make it true.
recipe.image_prompt_template: Our truck pulling into a quiet {street} at dusk, a porch light on, no people, no text, no logos, no lettering
recipe.motion_template: The truck rolls to a stop as the porch light comes on

en.primary_text: 360 Logistics is hiring Class A drivers for local dry van runs in Chicagoland. You are home every day — this is a dedicated route, not a rotation. Pay runs $28 per hour, with experienced drivers earning up to $32 per hour. Paid time off included. Must be 23+.
en.headline: Up to $32 per hour

es.primary_text: 360 Logistics busca conductores Clase A para rutas locales de van seca en Chicago. Ruta dedicada, a casa cada día. Pago de $28 a $32 por hora. Tiempo libre pagado. Mayores de 23 años.
es.headline: Hasta $32 por hora
